def to_file(self, filename=None, write_style=True):
        """
        >>> p = Preso()
        >>> z = p.to_file('/tmp/foo.odp')
        >>> sorted(z.ls('/'))
        ['META-INF/manifest.xml', 'content.xml', 'meta.xml', 'mimetype', 'settings.xml', 'styles.xml']
        """
        if filename is None:
            filename = self.filename
        if filename is None:
            raise ValueError('no filename given')
        if write_style:
            self.write_style()
        self.write_content()
        self.write_meta()
        self.write_settings()
        self.write_manifest()
        self.write_mimetype()
        z = zipfile.ZipFile(filename, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
        z.write(self.filename + '.styles.xml', 'styles.xml')
        z.write(self.filename + '.content.xml', 'content.xml')
        z.write(self.filename + '.meta.xml', 'meta.xml')
        z.write(self.filename + '.settings.xml', 'settings.xml')
        z.write(self.filename + '.manifest.xml', 'META-INF/manifest.xml')
        z.write(self.filename + '.mimetype', 'mimetype')
        z.close()
        return z
